feeds.title: The Oz Report
feeds.description: The Oz Report is a daily, worldwide hang gliding news ezine, with reports on competitions, pilot rankings, political issues, fly-ins, the latest technology, ultralight sailplanes, reader feedback and anything else from within the global HG community worthy of coverage.

feeds.title: Wills Wing Blog

Whether you're starting in the sport, a casual recreational flyer, or a seasoned competition pilot, there is a Wills Wing glider to fit your style of flying and experience level.
